_comment: The PRINT layer: everything the frame stage draws that GMNotes must not carry (SCED rule: printed text lives on art). Rules text transcribed from cards_v0.2 (errata-grade) and encounter_v0.4 §5/§5b; [wil]-style markup renders via cardforge/glyphs.py or the SE plugin's tags. Enemy combat stats exist only here. FLAG: The House Always Wins had no statline anywhere in the design docs — the one here is a DRAFT (owner to confirm).

sthrelias.text:
[reaction] When another investigator at your location would take 1 or more damage that is not direct damage: Elias takes that damage instead, then place 1 Memory on Elias. Limit once per round.
[reaction] After an enemy attack deals damage to Elias, if he is the only investigator at his location: Place 1 Memory on Elias. Limit once per round.
[elder] +1. If there are 3 or more Memory on Elias, this token is +3 instead, and heal 1 damage from Elias.
sthrelias.flavor: "I have died in this night more times than anyone. I'll stand between you and the dark once more."
sthrelias.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Survivor cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Ambergrove Lamp, "I've Done This Before", The Eighth Grave, 1 random basic weakness.
sthrelias.back_flavor: Lighthouse keeper of Ambergrove. He has died in this night more times than anyone, and he keeps standing between the town and the dark.

sthr-lamp.text:
Each investigator at your location gets +1 [agi] while evading.
[action] Exhaust the Ambergrove Lamp and raise Dissonance by 1: Look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then you may move to a connecting location.

sthr-donebefore.text: Commit only to a skill test you are performing. If you have already failed a test of this skill this loop, this card has [wild][wild][wild] instead of [wild].

sthr-eighthgrave.text: Revelation – Take 1 horror for each Memory on Elias (maximum 4). If there is no Memory on Elias, instead search the encounter deck and discard pile for an Echo enemy and spawn it engaged with you. Shuffle the encounter deck.
sthr-eighthgrave.flavor: You remember every time you did not come back.

sthrayako.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at an [int] test: Place 1 Memory on Ayako. Limit once per turn.
[elder] +2. Draw 1 card. If it is a Recollection, it costs 2 less to play this turn.
sthrayako.flavor: "The night is speaking a dead language. I intend to read it."
sthrayako.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Mystic cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Lexicon of the Hour, "It Means 'Wait'", Untranslatable, 1 random basic weakness.
sthrayako.back_flavor: A linguist who came to Ambergrove chasing a dead language — and found it being spoken by the night itself.

sthr-lexicon.text:
Uses (0 secrets).
[reaction] After you succeed at an [int] test by 2 or more: Place 1 secret here (maximum 5).
[free] Exhaust the Lexicon and spend 1 secret: +2 [int] for this test.
[reaction] When a Static treachery is drawn, exhaust the Lexicon and spend 1 secret: Cancel its revelation effect.

sthr-itmeanswait.text: Fast. Play when you would be affected by an Hour, Lost Hour, Slippage, The Crossing, The Appointed's Whisper or the Appointed. If there are 3 or more banked Memory, cancel that effect on you.
sthr-itmeanswait.flavor: Some of it is just a request to hold on.

sthr-untranslatable.text: Revelation — Take horror equal to half your banked Memory, rounded up (maximum 5).

sthrcass.text:
[free] Spend 2 resources: Name a chaos token symbol other than [autofail]. The next time you reveal a token with that symbol during a skill test this round, cancel it (it has no modifier and no symbol effect) and place 1 Memory on Cass. Limit once per turn.
[elder] +1. Gain 1 resource for each Memory on Cass (maximum +3 resources).
sthrcass.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 cards of any other class at level 0, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Marked Deck, "Seen This Hand Before", The House Always Wins, 1 random basic weakness.
sthrcass.back_flavor: A gambler who figured out the night resets three drinks before anyone else. She has been running the same hours for profit.

sthr-markeddeck.text:
[free] Exhaust Marked Deck: Reveal a random chaos token and seal it here. The next time you would reveal a chaos token during a skill test this round, resolve the sealed token instead and release it. At the end of the round, release it.
[free] Exhaust Marked Deck, raise Dissonance by 1 and remove 1 Memory from a card you control: Search the chaos bag for a non-symbol token and seal it on Marked Deck. Release it at the end of the round.
sthr-markeddeck.flavor: You already know how this hand plays.

sthr-seenthishand.text: Fast. Play when a chaos token is revealed during your skill test. Cancel that token (it has no modifier and no symbol effect) and gain 2 resources. If it was a symbol token, gain 3 resources instead.

sthr-housewins.text:
Hunter.
Spawn – The location with the most clues (the lead investigator chooses if tied). While Cass has more Memory on her cards than each other investigator, The House Always Wins cannot be evaded.
Forced – After The House Always Wins defeats an investigator: Remove 3 Memory from banked Memory.
sthr-housewins.flavor: The debt follows you across every loop.
sthr-housewins._stats_note: DRAFT statline — no source in the design docs; owner to confirm.

sthrseraphine.text:
[free] During your turn, raise Dissonance by 1: Choose one – You get +2 skill value for this skill test; or take an additional action this turn; or ready a Spell asset you control. Limit twice per round.
[elder] +X, where X is Dissonance (maximum +5). After this skill test ends, lower Dissonance by the amount this token added.
sthrseraphine.flavor: "I reached for the Hour. Perhaps it reached back."
sthrseraphine.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Seeker cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Bell of Ambergrove, "I Remember the Ending", The Debt of Hours, 1 random basic weakness.
sthrseraphine.back_flavor: A spiritualist who felt the Occultation coming and reached for it — and may be the reason the door is stuck open.

sthr-bell.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust the Bell of Ambergrove, spend 1 charge and raise Dissonance by 1: Advance or rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour.
sthr-bell.flavor: The bell marks the Hour. It can also un-mark it.

sthr-rememberending.text: Max once per loop. Test [wil] (X), where X is Dissonance. If you succeed, look at the next 3 Hours; the next time the Hourglass would advance this round, cancel that advance.
sthr-rememberending.flavor: You have seen how this night ends. Not this time.

sthr-debtofhours.text: Revelation – If Dissonance is in the Noticed band, advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage (if it is already Arrived, take 2 horror instead). If it is in the Glitch band, take 2 horror. If it is in the Calm band, raise Dissonance by 1.

sthrbirdie.text:
[reaction] After you fail a skill test by 2 or more: Place 1 Memory on Birdie. Limit once per round.
[reaction] When you would fail a skill test, remove 3 Memory from Birdie: You succeed at that test instead. Limit once per loop.
[elder] +1. If you have already failed a skill test this round, this token is +3 instead.
sthrbirdie.flavor: "Nobody believes a stranger. Suits me fine."
sthrbirdie.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 cards of any class at level 0–1, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lucky Compass, "I Get Out", Nobody Believes Her, 1 random basic weakness.
sthrbirdie.back_flavor: A young drifter who slipped into Ambergrove the wrong night and shouldn't remember a thing — but she does.

sthr-compass.text:
[action] Exhaust Lucky Compass: Move to a connecting location. (This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.)
If there are 2 or more Memory on Lucky Compass, you may instead move to a revealed location in a district whose surface or deep Knowledge entry your Campaign Log records.
sthr-compass.flavor: The needle always points at the way out.

sthr-igetout.text: Fast. Max once per loop. Play when you would be defeated by damage and/or horror. You are not defeated: heal damage and horror from you until you have 1 remaining health and 1 remaining sanity. Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a connecting location. Place 1 Memory on Lucky Compass.

sthr-nobodybelieves.text: Revelation – Until the end of the round, other investigators cannot target you or cards you control with card abilities, or take actions that affect you or cards you control. If you are the only investigator at your location, take 1 horror.

sthr-foreknowledge.text: When you commit this card, you may remove 1 Memory from a card you control. If you do, it has [wild][wild][wild] instead of [wild] for this test.

sthr-dejavu.text: Fast. As an additional cost, raise Dissonance by 1. Play after you resolve an [action], [free] or [reaction] ability on a card you control during your turn (not Déjà Vu). Trigger it again, paying its costs except any action cost.

sthr-musclememory.text: If you have already performed a test of this skill this loop, this card has [wild][wild] and you draw 1 card; otherwise it has [wild].

sthr-rehearsedescape.text: Evade. Max once per loop. As an additional cost, raise Dissonance by 1. Automatically evade an enemy engaged with you.
sthr-rehearsedescape.flavor: You have done this exact evade before.

sthr-longwayround.text: Move to a connecting location, then you may move to another connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and these moves do not advance the Hourglass.

sthr-borrowedtime.text:
Uses (3 charges). These charges are not Memory.
[free] Exhaust Borrowed Time and spend 1 charge: Gain 1 resource, or you get +1 skill value for a skill test you are performing.
sthr-borrowedtime.flavor: The sand runs upward, if you hold it right.

sthr-thistimeforsure.text: Fast. Play after you fail a skill test. As an additional cost, raise Dissonance by 1. Ignore that test's results and perform it again with the same skill and difficulty; you get +2 skill value for it.

sthr-anchorpoint.text:
Permanent.
Forced – At the start of each loop: Place 1 Memory on your investigator card.
sthr-anchorpoint.flavor: One fixed thing you always remember.

sthr-cassandrasnotebook.text: [reaction] After a Knowledge entry is recorded in your Campaign Log for the first time: Draw 2 cards. Limit once per loop.
sthr-cassandrasnotebook.flavor: The pages ahead are already filled.

sthr-hourlearnedname.text: Max once per loop. The Appointed must be at your location. Push it back one Approach stage (two if your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name), then rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour.

sthr-appointed.text:
Prey – Most Memory on their cards. As a hunter, it moves toward its prey even past nearer investigators.
The Appointed cannot be attacked, evaded, damaged or defeated. It leaves play only when pushed back to Unseen.
[action] Hold Back: Test [wil] (4) or [com] (4). This action does not provoke an attack of opportunity from the Appointed. If you succeed, push it back one Approach stage, disengage it and rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour.
sthr-appointed.flavor: It is not late. It was never late. You are simply early, every time.

sthr-appointedwhisper.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Take 1 horror. If the Appointed is Emerging or Arrived, take 2 horror instead and raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-crossing.text: Revelation — Advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage (to a minimum of Sensed). Then raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-crossing.flavor: A door stands free in the square. Its far side shows the same square, one hour later.

sthr-bellringer.text:
Retaliate.
Spawn – The Flooded Crypt.
Forced – When Hour III is reached, if the Bell-Ringer Beneath is in play: Ready it. It attacks the nearest investigator (the lead investigator breaks ties).
sthr-bellringer.flavor: It pulls the rope. The toll answers.

sthr-wearssheriff.text:
Hunter.
Spawn – The Records Office.
While What Wears the Sheriff is in play, the Records Office gets +1 shroud.
sthr-wearssheriff.flavor: It does not want you reading the ledger.

sthr-onewhorides.text:
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
Spawn – The Wheel.
While the One Who Rides Forever is ready, it cannot be dealt damage.
sthr-onewhorides.flavor: Round and round. It has always been riding. It will always be riding.

sthr-loc-lanternroom.text:
The lamp must be lit here before the stair will hold your weight.
[action] Investigate. If you succeed, you may light the Lantern (flip this location's investigators to the revealed side).
sthr-loc-lanternroom.flavor: The light remembers a path the dark has forgotten.

sthr-loc-keepersquarters.text:
Forced — When you enter the Keeper's Quarters: read the top card of the encounter deck.
Search here (2 clues) for the keeper's logbook.
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.flavor: Eight names in his own hand. The ninth is blank, and wet.

sthr-loc-square.text: The Square is always the loop's start location. Investigators begin here each loop.
sthr-loc-square.flavor: You wake with the taste of salt and the certainty you have done this before.

sthr-act-ninthdeath.text: Objective — Recover the keeper's logbook from the Keeper's Quarters (2 clues), then read the ninth death.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.flavor: You have died in this night more times than anyone.

sthr-story-firstdark.text: You wake at First Dark with the taste of salt and the certainty you have done this before. The others feel it too. No one in Ambergrove will believe you.

sthr-loc-windingstair.text: [action] Test [agility] (2) to climb. If you fail, take 1 damage.
sthr-loc-windingstair.flavor: The steps do not always number the same.

sthr-appointed-approach.text:
The Approach advances only when an effect says so: Hour V (to at least Sensed), Hour VII (at least Emerging), Hour VIII (Arrived); Dissonance entering the Glitch band (at least Sensed) or the Noticed band (Arrived); The Crossing and The Debt of Hours (1 stage). It never goes above Arrived.
When the Approach becomes Sensed or later while the Appointed is set aside, put it into play at the revealed location farthest from all investigators that is not closed (the lead investigator breaks ties). When it is pushed back to Unseen, set it aside.
While Sensed: It gains aloof and cannot move or attack. Forced – At the end of the round: Each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.
While Emerging: It gains hunter and cannot attack. Forced – After the Appointed engages an investigator: That investigator takes 1 horror.
While Arrived: It gains hunter. Forced – After the Appointed attacks: Raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-appointed-approach.flavor: It is not late. It was never late. You are simply early, every time.
